name: MD-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Mfume running with a large cash advantage
model.rationale: Mfume holds a heavily Democratic Baltimore-area seat, has out-raised his little-known Republican opponent, and markets price his reelection at 96%. With no contrary polling or ratings, the fundamentals support a Safe D forecast.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race, or a major outside-spending surge for Collier, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kweisi Mfume seeks another term in a Baltimore-area district that leans Democratic by more than 30 points. He enters the general election as a well-established incumbent with roughly $700,000 on hand, while Republican Scott Collier has reported minimal fundraising and little outside support. No independent pollster has surveyed the race, and no expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and financial positioning.

Prediction markets give Mfume about a 96% chance of winning, consistent with the district's strong Democratic tilt and the incumbent's advantages. The expected margin is roughly 29 points, with meaningful uncertainty given the absence of polling. Barring an unexpected external shock, Mfume is heavily favored to hold the seat.
